objective: Implement PRD-defined MCP tools, recall behavior, coverage/OOD responses, active-memory serving rules, and agent-facing access boundaries.
implementation_summary: Repaired serve tool dispatch so recall, coverage, and assess tool calls validate only rules served by that tool response.
Preserved manifest-only serve behavior that fails closed when any active served rule has malformed citations.
Added regression tests proving unrelated malformed active-rule citations do not block matched recall or no_coverage coverage tool responses.
Repaired serve assess command-envelope artifact and evidence refs so external input paths use the redacted external-input display path.

review_findings_addressed.summary: Tool calls should not validate unrelated active rules before returning matched recall or coverage/no_coverage responses.
serve --tool assess should not leak raw external input paths through command-envelope artifact or evidence refs.
